remarks: Lovely 2 Bedroom Condo for Rent Near Glenbrook. This well maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath unit has a large living room and eat-in kitchen with new appliances. It is ideally situated just a few minutes' drive to Cove Beach Park. This second-floor unit has been freshly painted and is filled with natural light, ensuring a welcoming environment. There are two parking spaces in the rear off-street lot for your convenience. Coin-operated laundry is available in the complex. There is a large storage area with an assigned storage box for personal use. With convenient access to Chelsea Piers, parks, shopping, and dining options, this location offers both comfort and convenience. Enjoy summers at the beach! Commuters will appreciate the easy access to I-95 as well as nearby public transportation, making daily travel hassle-free. Included in the rent are heat and hot water, providing additional value. Don't miss out on the chance to make this lovely condo unit your new home!
